reflection.text:
I correctly detected cytotoxic rounding and division failure but assigned it to the wrong cytoskeleton. Low density on microscopy (e5), cell_area z=-8.4 with frac_multinucleate_proxy z=+8.4 at 1 uM (e2), frac_large_nucleus z=+53.7 (e18), and cell_count Spearman rho=-0.90 (e17) are classic for cytochalasin B cytokinesis failure, and I recorded them yet kept Actin disruptors at 0.03.
